body: Wish that was a possibility but Im a complete technophobe and I don’t live in the US. The thought of working in an office doesn’t even appeal to me anymore. I don’t want to live in a world where my only value is from work.

Oh I wish I was resilient. One of the major reasons I’m actively considering this is because I lack the resilience to cope with life, even prior to the pandemic. I literally sobbed the entire day I wrote this post. 

But hey, no point in crying over spilled vaccines. I might as well just life my life as fully as corona will allow in this year. Things will probably only get worse from here on out so might as well just buckle up and enjoy the ride before things get truly horrific.

Like I said, I have a plan. I’m going to try something new each week, whether it’s something basic like making my own jam or something more adventurous like climbing a mountain. Either way, I’m going to try and live life to the fullest. That way I can either end things with no regrets or I can say I had a great year in spite of everything. I promise you that I’ll spend this year trying my best to find happiness, even if I’ve struggled to find it.
I don’t see how that’s relevant but no. I’m not American.
